Titles/Tax/Registration
We are a CA retail dealer, regulated by the state. Any private buyers who reside in CA and choose to register their cars in state will be charged CA state tax, and lucky for them we handle all the paperwork and smog (where applicable) for them! Buyers in all other states; we do not need to collect any taxes or fees. We do not charge any documentation fees. Titles are sent via FedEx Express after payment and paperwork is processed. AZ buyers: every auction we get an enormous amount of emails and calls asking if we can sell privately so you do not need to pay tax. We are a retail dealership and sell as such so please plan your bids and finances accordingly.
Please note: 2025 California DMV rule changes now make sales to out of state LLC’s much more difficult to process for CA retail dealerships such as ourselves. As such we will happily sell to any out-of-state LLC:-who titles as an LLC which holds a dealer license or-who titles as an LLC and allows us to directly set up and facilitate shipping, (at the buyer’s cost) to an out-of-state address

Commenting
We LOVE the comments and the comment section! We love the knowledge, the discussion and the banter! We highly encourage informed and kind discussion and like being part of it too. But be sure to note the comment rules to make sure your comment does not get flagged by other members or C&B

Best of luck to the bidders and enjoy!

Inspections
We welcome all inspections and encourage bidders to set up any in which they like! The time to schedule inspections is during the auction period, not after, so please be sure to reach out early to schedule your in-person or 3rd party inspections. One of the best things about C&B is their reach, but that also means that slots for viewing can fill up fast! Also note all cars unless otherwise noted are being sold as-is and no warranty. We do our best to understand and vet every car as well as express all that we know, but this does not mean even the most reliable car is infallible. Cars are as close to living breathing things out there!

Carfax
Carfax is a nice tool, but a reference at best. It is in no way a complete picture of a car and accuracy of information can vary. This varies from simple and obvious typos to missing info to complete erroneous entries. Also most dealers and shops in SoCal do not sell their info to Carfax, so a missing entry for service does not mean no service. The best advice is to use a combination of common sense and personal due diligence. We are collectors and buyers as much as the next guy so we use the same basis in buying.

Bidding and Winning!
This is an important one! First, some tips!-Be sure to reach out via the Contact Seller button above with ANY questions you may have. We love to answer questions, but also please note, often the volume is substantial, so please be patient if it takes a day to respond. We are on PST as well as a consideration. -Be sure to schedule any inspections you desire prior to bidding-Please review the entire gallery, read the full ad and full comment section-Be sure that your credit card is up to date with C&B -The timer will reset for an additional 2 minutes for any bid made under the 2 minute mark. No need to show us how good (or bad) your WiFi is, so bid with enough time left!
WAY too many auctions are ending with folks not refreshing their pages or waiting until 0:01 sec to bid only to lose out!
-Refresh occasionally
-Bid at 2:00 or more!

Please enjoy the bidding process!!!!! It is a huge part of the fun! But also please take bidding seriously! -DO NOT BID if you do not have pre-approved or readily accessible funds! We are partners with both Woodside Credit and Leasing and happy to provide rates not seen on the “street”! Use the Contact Seller button above to reach out!-DO NOT BID if you are just trying to entertain yourself and have no intent on winning. The auction price may end lower than expected!-DO NOT BID if you have not read the ad and thoroughly reviewed the gallery!

Both C&B and we take this very seriously and do not enjoy or tolerate non-paying bidders. We are not a faceless corporation with unlimited money. We are a business which relies on a return on the massive outlay of capital and time to pay its employees, bills and of course to support our families like most all other folks. Please enjoy bidding and buying ONLY when you are ready to own a new car.
Please note, space is always at a premium. We offer 2 weeks of free storage post auction and charge a very reasonable rate thereafter.

While this is a long post, it is worth the read not only to educate, but to create the best, most enjoyable and frankly fun auction experience here on C&B After selling well over a thousand cars online, we see a lot of the same questions and requests, so the hope is to make a post that helps smooth out some of those questions below before they are asked.

First and foremost, be sure to hit the |☆ Watch | button above to be kept up to date as we add more pictures and videos. We like to add them throughout the auction and with everyone’s busy lives, it is easy to miss an auction end! Be sure to schedule your PPI early as spots can fill up fast!
Next, a note for all bidders or potential bidders.
Please don’t be a stranger! Use the Contact Seller button to reach out to say hello! We love hearing from our bidders or would be bidders. Not only to put a name to a screen name and chat, but also to answer any questions. That’s what we are here for. But especially if you are bidding we encourage an email just to even say “Hi, I’m John and I’m bidding!”

How It All Works
First, for any newcomers certainly read this links, but even worth reviewing for old timers; the How it Works section https://carsandbids.com/what-is/

Photos and Videos
Nearly every auction we see questions about various aspects of photos. Some common questions/statements with our thoughts below:

I Need Outdoor Shots!
Not to worry, we add outdoor to nearly every auction of ours, so if you do not see them in the gallery below yet, make sure that Watch button above is clicked! But in most cases they are in the gallery too. I think it’s worth mentioning as there is usually someone who asks about the merits of studio vs outdoor and there are pros and cons to each. We have found that the indoor light is quite a lot better at showing actual condition. I think there is an idea that somehow the indoor shots hide flaws when it is really quite the opposite. The indoor lights will show a fly’s eyelash left on a car and we spend quite a bit of time on every car making sure that they are prime time ready. The light is more consistent and because it’s controllable, it allows for pictures unaffected by clouds, time of day, angle, background and more. Outdoor shots have their place for sure and with certain paints can show off the flip/flop of pearls and highlight some colors more, but with the sun creating shadows and highlights, creates incredibly inconsistent shots that often times hides condition or hyper exaggerates it. We like both and we generally show both, but I definitely like sharing the experience of us having photographed thousands and thousands of cars that the studio makes for a more truthful environment for condition in most scenarios.

Do you Photoshop your Pictures?
We do not retouch any flaws on cars in post-edit or photoshop nor add filters. We spend a ton of time and effort in making the cars not only photo ready but employing insanely talented photographers that take wonderful looking and accurate photos. In general, the only thing that we will edit is the shadows of the background to adjust darker or lighter in order to more effectively make the focus on the car.

Videos
If you do not see videos yet, don’t worry. Like outdoor photos please note the same as above and we add more content throughout even down to the last days. Most all cars we upload both a drive and walk around and sometimes more! So hit the Watch button!

Does the Car Come with “_____”?
We post everything we have on the car in the gallery: accessories, keys, car covers etc. We post records as we have them and be sure to check the Carfax for additional info
